title: Polynomial-time unary truncated subtraction
statement: Let $f,g$ be functions from finite bit strings to the natural numbers. If the unary string functions $x\mapsto 1^{f(x)}$ and $x\mapsto 1^{g(x)}$ are polynomial-time computable, then so is $x\mapsto 1^{\max(f(x)-g(x),0)}$, with subtraction interpreted as truncated natural-number subtraction.
hypotheses_covered: The unary string function determined by $f$ is polynomial-time computable
The unary string function determined by $g$ is polynomial-time computable
